note: DropBlock's in-game radio manifest. Deliberately game-local (NOT the shared cross-game network) so the dial only carries Polkahole + DropBlock's 3 originals — no other game's tracks. Polkahole loops The Rooster's Falsetto + The Polka Man Prevails on repeat. The 3 DropBlock originals were re-synthesized 2026-11-15 as deep synth (detuned-saw lead + synced echo, square bass + sub, sidechain, pads, full kit, bus reverb) — same melodies as the original in-game chiptune.
